attributes.cardDescription: Create a completion goal from a curated list of products, with a name and a completion rule.
attributes.readMe:
## Create Set

The spec's `CreateSet` tool. Resolves a caller-supplied list of product ids into real `linksToMany` entries on a new `CompletionSet`.

### No matrix concept existed

Confirmed absent from all 590 tracker rows — a pure new command.

### Example

This command has no single natural input card — it takes a list of product ids, not one target instance. `linkedExamples` links `CompletionSet/travis-scott-nike` illustratively, as the SHAPE of what this command produces, not as a literal input it was run against; noted here rather than left for the next reader to assume otherwise.

### Membership is curated, not a query

Matches `completion-set.gts`'s own header note: sneaker sets are emergent and personal, so `products` is a hand-confirmed `linksToMany`, never a saved filter. `targetCount` is a computed field on the card itself — this command never writes it directly.
